findings.summary: The page recommends asyncio.to_thread for CPU-heavy work, but because of the GIL, to_thread is really meant for blocking I/O.
findings.evidence: ["CPU-heavy loop","`await asyncio.to_thread(f)`"]
findings.fix: Change the CPU row to `await loop.run_in_executor(ProcessPoolExecutor(), f)`, or note that to_thread only helps CPU work that releases the GIL.
